title: All Systems Red
author: Martha Wells
summary: A security android has hacked its own control module and secretly spends its time watching serials while pretending to obey. When a survey mission it guards is attacked, it has to decide how much it cares.
readIf: you want a short, sardonic space story with a narrator who would rather be left alone.
skipIf: you want a complete, self-contained epic, since it is a novella and the larger story continues in sequels.

pairings.reason: Another short, humane story about a robot and a person learning to understand one another.
The classic robot stories that this kind of reluctant machine hero grew out of.
Another sarcastic narrator in a dangerous situation with lots of competence and humour.
